'''B6-31''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In [[3639 BBY]] it was stationed in the [[Section X]] area of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], where he asked a Republic operative to check the wreckage of the ''[[Fatality]]'' cruiser in the [[Frozen Lake]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
B6-31 was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Update 1.5.<ref name="SWTOR" />
